parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description: IPv6 address N to unassign. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: Ipv6Prefix
parameters.description: IPv6 prefix N to unassign. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the ENI. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs unassign-ipv6-addresses --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-interface-id eni-bp14v2sdd3v8ht0000 --ipv6-address 2001:db8:1234:1a00::000 --ipv6-prefix 2001:db8:1234:1a00:0000::/80 --region cn-hangzhou
